recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14282; any future editorial cleanup of the current active wording, such as grammar polish in SourceStructureMapExtension.fsh, belongs in the HL7/sdc IG.
issue_request: FHIR-14282 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested clearer descriptions for Questionnaire sourceStructureMap and targetStructureMap so the maps are described in terms of QuestionnaireResponses for/of the Questionnaire rather than the Questionnaire resource itself.
initial_application: No commit directly mentioning FHIR-14282 was found. Core commit 9b1695bfd416c4f23560a3e60b999b6c5600db58, merged by ecdd7d617e57078d07b4af5eb95432e3e6065bac, removed the sourceStructureMap and targetStructureMap rows from the core Questionnaire extension spreadsheet with the clarified QuestionnaireResponse-focused wording present. SDC commit 91958f6ab08b3a98dac17b557024826456c6eae0 then added the moved SDC definitions with that clarified wording.
additional_context: FHIR-19527 later moved questionnaire-sourceStructureMap and questionnaire-targetStructureMap from core to the SDC IG, and that related issue is already represented on the combined branch by commit 5babcfe4755f2e5c5b3d03460d570ed25778052c. Current core source has Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse active in source/fhir.ini, but the old core extension ids appear only in tools/history/release3/extension-definitions.xml, a frozen historical artifact. The current SDC source defines active sdc-questionnaire-sourceStructureMap and sdc-questionnaire-targetStructureMap extensions with the requested QuestionnaireResponse-focused semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was edited because the active extension definitions are outside this checkout and editing the remaining release3 history file would not correct a current build input.
